The Tiger tank struck more fear into Allied crews than any other tank on the battlefield. Its 88mm gun tore through Allied armor while shells bounced harmlessly off its hull. Michael Wittmann proved why—destroying 14 tanks in just 15 minutes. But was the Tiger really as unstoppable as legend claims? #SimpleHistory
